collect_note: New NOAA Climate Program Office regional-team competitions (RISA, now Climate Adaptation Partnerships) are read from Grants.gov twice a day by title and wait for review before showing. Nothing is open now: the FY2026 round (NOAA-OAR-CPO-2026-33094) closed June 2026.
evidence: Plain HTTP POST 2026-11-12 to https://api.grants.gov/v1/api/search2. cpo.noaa.gov returns HTTP 403 to curl and an empty 202 page to the recon tool, so no site channel is readable (bot_protected). {keyword:'Climate Adaptation Partnerships Regional Integrated Sciences and Assessments', oppStatuses:'forecasted|posted|archived'} returned the past RISA/CAP NOFOs including NOAA-OAR-CPO-2024-2008024 'Climate Adaptation Partnerships Program FY2024', NOAA-OAR-CPO-2022-2007019 RISA FY2022, NOAA-OAR-CPO-2021-2006677 RISA FY2021 (the title filter matches all of them); with forecasted|posted only, none of these is open now and no agencies key is used because the 2026 NOFO's agency is 'DOC NOAA - ERA Production' while older ones are 'Department of Commerce'. oppNum NOAA-OAR-CPO-2026-33094 returns the archived 2026 NOFO (id 362258, close 06/10/2026). aln is not honored by search2. No RSS/feed or sitemap readable on cpo.noaa.gov.
